assessment.title: A recorded measurement
assessment.description: An Assessment is one immutable measurement of one kind, made by an Assessor. A PanGloss run may produce several Assessments, such as parse timing and correctness for a Selection.

baseline.title: A saved project starting point
baseline.description: A Baseline is a saved, minimal, file-backed copy of a project from which Motif can make independent Dry Run copies. When captured from a project FieldWorks holds open, it reflects FieldWorks' last save.

default-selection.title: Words measured by default
default-selection.description: A project's Default Selection is the chosen Texts plus any added words Motif measures when no other Selection is named. Motif resolves it to an exact word list for each run.

drift.title: Evidence no longer matches
drift.description: Drift means a Dry Run or an individual change no longer matches the project state it was made against. In the window, a change with missing or changed inputs is shown as ‘no longer fits’.

dry-run.title: Effects measured on a copy
dry-run.description: A Dry Run applies a Proposal to a throwaway project copy and reads back the effects. It leaves the live model unchanged.

overview.title: The latest stored evidence
overview.description: The Overview presents project counts and measurements already recorded by Motif. Reading it does not start a Refresh or a parse.

parse-all-words.title: Parse every chosen word
parse-all-words.description: Parse all words asks PanGloss to parse the words you chose and saves the result against the Baseline. A search stopped at a limit is saved as not finished, never as a word that cannot parse.

preflight.title: The final fit check
preflight.description: The CLI's preflight command checks changes against the live model before Apply. A change whose required inputs changed or disappeared no longer fits.

proposal.title: A reviewable set of changes
proposal.description: A Proposal groups related Motif operations so a person can inspect, measure, and apply them as one unit.

text-coverage.title: Share of your text that parses
text-coverage.description: Text Coverage is the share of the Default Selection's words, and of their occurrences in the chosen Texts, that parse. The same share measured over a Corpus is called grammar coverage.

walkthrough.title: A tested window guide
walkthrough.description: A Walkthrough is a script that tests the real Motif window using fixed data and produces screenshots at marked steps. It can also render a short, silent clip.
